report.scope: Measurements from this runtime only. Software Vulkan is not Android performance. Resource accounting excludes driver/cache/CPU allocations. RSS and PSS are separate process metrics, not dedicated GPU memory. Temperature is reported only when an explicitly named GPU sensor is readable.
report.selection_scope: Camera frustum only, over immutable source-page bounds. Full jobs retained for shadow casters and light field. Whole-instance sample jobs are skipped without changing captures, LOD, source ownership or resolution. Paired deterministic camera paths; compare within this device, never infer Android FPS from software Vulkan.
